attchmntText: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has uploaded the audio recording of its earnings conference call held on November 12, 2026. The call discussed the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at the specified link. This intimation is submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The filing was made by Deepa Bansal, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Submission Of Key Performance Indicator Data Book for Q2 FY27 Of Ola Electric Mobility Limited
voiceSummary: Ola Electric Mobility Limited submitted its Key Performance Indicator Data Book for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. The intimation will also be hosted on the company website at www.olaelectric.com. The document was signed by Deepa Bansal, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, in Bengaluru on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Shareholders letter for Q2 FY 27'.
voiceSummary: Ola Electric Mobility Limited submitted its Shareholders’ Letter for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue from operations of 421 crore rupees and a gross margin of 29.93 percent. Operating expenses were 369 crore rupees, resulting in an adjusted operating EBITDA of negative 246 crore rupees. The company stated that demand is no longer a constraint, with supply chain ramp-up being the primary focus. Auto borrowings decreased from 2,422 crore rupees in December 2024 to 337 crore rupees in September 2026. The dealer network expanded to 255 partners operating over 300 stores as of November 8, 2026. In the Cell business, the company achieved SCOD for 6 GWh of capacity and received a government extension of its ACC PLI scheme to CY2031.

attchmntText: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Ola Electric Mobility Limited submitted an investor presentation for its earnings conference call regarding the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a gross margin of 29.93% and operating expenses of 369 crore rupees. Total borrowings decreased to 1,819 crore rupees from 3,132 crore rupees in December 2024. Auto borrowings reduced to 337 crore rupees. The company has appointed 255 dealer partners operating over 300 stores as of November 8, 2026. Production is ramping up with an expectation of 25,000 vehicles in December. The government extended the ACC PLI scheme to calendar year 2031. The company achieved SCOD for 6 GWh of cell capacity.

attchmntText: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ola Electric Mobility Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half-Year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors held its meeting on November 12, 2026, from 03:15 PM to 03:45 PM IST. The financial results include a Limited Review Report issued by M/s. B S R & Co. LLP, the Statutory Auditors. The company has submitted these results to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. Copies of the financial results are enclosed with the announcement. The intimation will also be hosted on the company website at www.olaelectric.com. Deepa Bansal, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication from Bengaluru.

attchmntText: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has informed the Exchange about schedule of Earnings Conference Call-Q2 FY 2026-27
voiceSummary: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has announced the schedule for its earnings conference call for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call will take place on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 05:00 P.M. IST. The event is intended for analysts and investors to discuss the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results. Management representatives including Bhavish Aggarwal, Founder, Chairman and Managing Director, and Deepak Rastogi, Chief Financial Officer, will participate. An invitation with a registration link is available on the company website at www.olaelectric.com. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
